```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10,
  fig.height = 8,
  dpi = 300
)

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(DiagrammeR)
library(rsvg)
library(DiagrammeRsvg)
library(glue)
library(gt)
library(gtsummary)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(scales)
library(webshot2)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(sf)
library(haven)
library(ggridges)
library(png)
library(tiff)

dir.create(here("figures", "main"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(here("figures", "supplement"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
load(here("data_processed", "03_cohort_with_variables_v2.rda"))
counts <- readRDS(here("data_processed", "02_cohort_counts_v2.rds"))
load(here("data_processed", "01_raw_data_v2.rda"))
```

```{r global-config, include=FALSE}
source(here("00_global_config.r"), local = knitr::knit_global())
```

## Survival estimates (reference table, not in the supplement)

```{r prepare-survival, include=FALSE}
source(here("sf_survival.r"), local = knitr::knit_global())
```

```{r survival-estimates, results='asis'}
surv_table %>%
  gt::gt() %>%
  gt::cols_label(
    `Donor Type` = "Donor Type",
    Outcome = "Outcome",
    `Time (years)` = "Time (years)",
    Group = "Group",
    `Survival (%)` = "Survival (%)",
    `N at risk` = "N at risk"
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_options(table.font.size = 14)
```

## EP validation (reported in Supplement Methods 2)

```{r ep-validation, results='hide'}
source(here("sf_ep_validation.r"), local = knitr::knit_global())
```

```{r ep-validation-show, results='asis'}
ep_validation_table %>%
  gt::gt() %>%
  gt::tab_header(title = "EP validation against OPTN 6-month monitoring report") %>%
  gt::tab_options(table.font.size = 14)
```
